# cairn identity

Manage vault identities (§3.5 / §4.1)

## Help

```text
Manage vault identities (§3.5 / §4.1)

Usage: identity <COMMAND>

Commands:
  status            Show vault identity health report
  list              List operational identities
  show              Show a single identity record
  provision         Provision a new identity
  init-defaults     Provision the default human and agent identities
  rotate            Rotate the signing key for an identity
  revoke            Revoke an identity (two-phase WAL tombstone)
  reconcile         Bulk repair all pending identity rows
  repair            Repair state-machine for a single identity
  purge             Permanently purge an identity (requires .cairn/maintenance/purge-ack file)
  vault-id-recover  Recover or reconstruct the .cairn/vault.id file
  finalise-binding  Resume or abandon a partial first-bind after a crash
  help              Print this message or the help of the given subcommand(s)

Options:
  -h, --help
          Print help
```
